texts: Who is the chief Keeper of Aelmere?

fields.sentence: Who is the chief Keeper of Aelmere?

q2_gaps: of-phrase on an agent-nominalization used as an office/role title ('the chief Keeper of Aelmere'): the instruction set routes a 'role' relational noun to the genitive Possession, but also routes any noun whose underlying verb would take the of-NP as object to the entity-attached surface-preposition oblique (Of ...) by the verb-paraphrase test ('the N of X' = 'what Vs X'); keeper satisfies both, and nothing says which wins
review.notes: chief_keeper follows the role-title fusion line and the capitalized-common-noun default (no Name atom for 'Keeper'), Aelmere is bound by Name, and the wh-answer variable is correctly left bare and unnamed. The Possession-vs-Of choice is the only live risk: a statement stored with (Of ...) would not match this query.
